k3v63-k5v80.descriptionZh: 面向工程机械的斜盘式轴向柱塞双泵，多种控制方式，可选 PTO 配置。
k3v63-k5v80.descriptionEn: Swash plate axial piston tandem pumps for mobile machinery, with multiple control options and optional PTO.

k3v112-k5v140.descriptionZh: 面向 20–28 吨级履带挖掘机，同时适用于混凝土设备、钻机等开式液压回路。
k3v112-k5v140.descriptionEn: For 20–28 tonne crawler excavators and other open-circuit applications, including concrete equipment and drilling rigs.

k3v140-k3v180.descriptionZh: 覆盖多种排量配置的工程机械双泵系列，为不同设备提供液压动力选型。
k3v140-k3v180.descriptionEn: A tandem pump family with multiple displacement options for construction equipment.

k5v200.descriptionZh: 面向重型设备的串联双泵系列，提供产品尺寸、液压回路及配件选型资料。
k5v200.descriptionEn: Tandem pumps for heavy machinery, supported by dimensional, circuit and component documentation.

k3v280.descriptionZh: K3V 系列大排量双泵，适用于需要较大液压动力的设备选型。
k3v280.descriptionEn: A large-displacement tandem pump in the K3V family for demanding hydraulic applications.

k3v-k5v-single.descriptionZh: 斜盘式轴向柱塞单泵，提供多种规格和控制配置，服务工业与工程机械应用。
k3v-k5v-single.descriptionEn: Swash plate axial piston single pumps in multiple sizes and control configurations for industrial and mobile applications.

k7v.descriptionZh: 面向工程机械的 K7V 系列，提供结构剖视、规格参数与安装尺寸资料。
k7v.descriptionEn: The K7V family for mobile machinery, with cutaway views, specifications and installation dimensions.

k3vl.zh: 工业用斜盘式轴向柱塞泵
k3vl.en: Industrial swash plate axial piston pump
k3vl.descriptionZh: 覆盖 28–200 cm³ 规格，服务工业液压与移动机械，提供负载敏感、恒压等控制方式及辅助齿轮泵连接配置。
k3vl.descriptionEn: Sizes from 28 to 200 cm³ for industrial and mobile hydraulics, with load-sensing and constant-pressure controls and auxiliary gear-pump connection options.

k3vg.zh: 工业用斜盘式轴向柱塞泵
k3vg.en: Industrial swash plate axial piston pump
k3vg.descriptionZh: 提供 63、112、180、280、180DT 与 280DT 六种规格，面向注塑成型机、压力机及船用甲板机械等工业液压应用。
k3vg.descriptionEn: Six sizes—63, 112, 180, 280, 180DT and 280DT—for industrial hydraulics including injection molding, presses and marine deck machinery.

f5sp.descriptionZh: 紧凑型液压泵系列，样本包含泵体结构、液压回路与性能参数。
f5sp.descriptionEn: A compact hydraulic pump family with structural, hydraulic circuit and performance documentation.

m5x-frg.descriptionZh: 由斜盘式柱塞马达与两级行星减速机构组成，为挖掘机回转提供集成驱动。
m5x-frg.descriptionEn: An integrated swash plate piston motor and two-stage planetary reducer for excavator swing applications.

fsm-rd.descriptionZh: 将柱塞马达与减速机构集成，提供回转装置结构、性能及安装尺寸资料。
fsm-rd.descriptionEn: Integrated piston motor and reducer assemblies, supported by structural, performance and installation documentation.

fdnb.descriptionZh: 集成斜盘式柱塞马达与行星减速机构，服务履带式设备行走驱动。
fdnb.descriptionEn: Integrated swash plate piston motor and planetary reduction for tracked equipment travel drives.

ftd.descriptionZh: 柱塞马达与减速机构组成的行走驱动系列，覆盖多种履带式工程设备。
ftd.descriptionEn: Travel drives combining piston motors with reduction gearing for a range of tracked machines.

hmc-hmb.descriptionZh: HMC 变排量双速与 HMB 定排量单速径向柱塞马达，面向破碎、塑料机械、隧道与船舶设备等应用。
hmc-hmb.descriptionEn: HMC variable-displacement two-speed and HMB fixed-displacement single-speed radial piston motors for industrial and marine applications.

pump-motor-parts.descriptionZh: 泵、马达与减速机构配件，结合爆炸图、零件编号和设备信息完成匹配。
pump-motor-parts.descriptionEn: Pump, motor and reduction gear components matched using exploded views, part references and machine information.

fp20v.descriptionZh: FP20V 工业用斜盘式轴向柱塞泵，提供恒压、负载敏感及恒功率控制方式。样本列有装载机、混凝土设备、泵站与工业机械应用，可选通轴驱动配置。
fp20v.descriptionEn: FP20V swash plate axial piston pumps for industrial applications, with pressure, load-sensing and horsepower control options. Documented applications include wheel loaders, concrete equipment, pump units and industrial machinery; through-drive configurations are optional.

ffd.descriptionZh: 用于顶锤式液压钻机凿岩机进给系统的 FFD 系列马达。样本列示变排量两速结构，并配置平衡阀和缓冲溢流阀以减小停机冲击。
ffd.descriptionEn: FFD feed motors for drifter feed systems in top-hammer hydraulic drilling rigs. The brochure describes a variable-displacement two-speed design with a counterbalance valve and shockless relief valve to reduce stopping impact.

fp3vg.descriptionZh: 面向工业压力机应用的 FP3VG 斜盘式柱塞泵。样本提供流量、压力和功率等多种控制方式，并列有辅助齿轮泵选装能力。
fp3vg.descriptionEn: FP3VG swash plate piston pumps for industrial press applications. The brochure lists flow, pressure and horsepower control options, together with optional auxiliary gear-pump mounting.

fpz-fpx.descriptionZh: 用于工业压力机等设备的 FPZ / FPX 轴向柱塞泵系列。总册同时收录面向挤出机应用的 FPZ Rotas 电液伺服控制机型，配置需按具体工况确认。
fpz-fpx.descriptionEn: FPZ / FPX axial piston pumps for industrial presses and related equipment. The brochure also includes the FPZ Rotas electro-hydraulic servo-controlled variant for extruder applications; configurations require application-specific confirmation.

es-servo.descriptionZh: 由 FP20V 泵与伺服电机组成的 ES SERVO 动力方案。通过伺服电机变速调节所需流量，样本列有钢铁工业应用，以及卸荷时停机或低速运行的控制方式。
es-servo.descriptionEn: ES SERVO combines an FP20V pump with a servo motor. Variable-speed control supplies hydraulic flow on demand; the brochure lists steel-industry applications and stopped or low-speed operation during unloading.

eppr.descriptionZh: 用于混凝土设备、叉车等应用的 EPPR 插装式控制阀。样本列示紧凑结构、可选滤网、快速响应和低泄漏特性。
eppr.descriptionEn: EPPR cartridge-type control valves for applications including concrete equipment and forklifts. The brochure lists a compact design, optional screen filter, fast response and low leakage.

mcv.descriptionZh: 面向叉车应用的 MCV 多路控制阀，采用开中心系统和分片式工作元件。提供并联或并联加串联回路形式，样本列示最高工作压力为 25 MPa。
mcv.descriptionEn: MCV control valves for forklift applications, with an open-center system and sectional work elements. Parallel and parallel-plus-tandem circuits are listed, with a maximum operating pressure of 25 MPa.

steering-gear.descriptionZh: 船用舵机系列，包含电液舵机与电机控制舵机。总册列示舵机扭矩覆盖 33–1030 ton·m；具体控制方案、系统配置与船型要求需结合项目确认。
steering-gear.descriptionEn: Marine steering gear covering electro-hydraulic and motor-control configurations. The brochure lists a steering-torque range of 33–1030 ton·m; controls, system configuration and vessel requirements require project-specific confirmation.

deck-machinery.descriptionZh: 面向船舶锚泊与系泊作业的甲板机械系列，覆盖电液、电动和电液自容式配置。可结合船型、操控方式及安装要求选型，具体功能需按配置确认。
deck-machinery.descriptionEn: Deck machinery for marine anchoring and mooring, including electro-hydraulic, electric and electro-hydraulic self-contained configurations. Selection depends on vessel, controls and installation requirements; features vary by configuration.
